questions.question: During a famine, Naomi's family left Bethlehem to live in which land?
After about ten years living in Moab, what new loss did Naomi suffer?

answers.text: Her house in Moab burned down
She fell sick and lost her sight

questions.question: Ruth told her mother-in-law Naomi, "Your people will be my people." What else did Ruth promise?

answers.text: Your God will be my God
I will take care of your house
I will learn all the ways of Judah
